text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: RDMA retransmit rate > 12% observed across rack-7. Serving errors rising (500s + CUDA timeouts). Affected routes: /api/generate (model: rwd-xl). Estimated impact ~2% of traffic. Paging @oncall-mike.

oncall-mike: ack — I'm on it. quick triage: are we seeing container restarts or pure network retries? any customer reports yet?

sarah-ops: seeing container restarts on node-7-19 and node-7-21. runtime logs show repeated CUDA context kills around kernel 450. also high retransmit counters on the IB iface. sample log: `runtime: cudaErrorUnknown: driver timeout, context destroyed`

dave-sre: /cc @anya-ml if we hit cuda context kills that's likely due to retries piling up + KV cache pressure. can we route traffic to dedicated pools or fallback quantized model to avoid OOMs?

anya-ml: quick option: switch to quantized_v2 fallback (less memory) — increases latency but avoids CUDA OOMs. we can flip routing for 50-70% of traffic temporarily.

oncall-mike: executing plan: 1) enable route throttle to 70% for /api/generate 2) enable model-fallback to quantized_v2 3) drain node-7-19 for investigation 4) notify support. draining will kill inflight requests on that node, ok?

sarah-ops: starting drain — running commands now:
```
kubectl cordon node-7-19
kubectl drain node-7-19 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

sarah-ops: network checks while draining: `iblinkstat` shows excessive retransmits, `ethtool -S eth2` shows tx_retrans=4820, `rdma_netstat -s` -> ib_retrans_total ~ 18%. ibport counters show sporadic link down events around 04:11Z.

dave-sre: rolling route change: shifting 65% traffic -> quantized_v2. patching route config now.

incident-bot: Service config update: traffic shift applied (65% -> quantized_v2). Throttling enabled on /api/generate (70%). :white_check_mark:

leo-support: I'm drafting an outbound update for customers that saw errors. TL;DR: brief degradation due to network instability; we mitigated via model fallback and node isolation. Will post to status if needed.

anya-ml: hypothesis: multipath path selection oscillation + MTU mismatch causing fragmented frames and retransmits => queuing in the host and then CUDA contexts starve and crash. Recommend check MTU across HCA + switch.

dave-sre: agree. quick mitigation: disable multipath on those nodes and unify MTU to 4092 (previously some hosts at 1500). executing small changes on rack-7 (one node at a time).

sarah-ops: command outputs while we applied change:
```
# before
ip link show dev eth2 mtu 1500
# after
ip link set dev eth2 mtu 4092
ibstat mlx5_0
  port 1: state: ACTIVE
  phys_state: LINK_UP
```

dave-sre: note — disabled multipath policy on node-7-20 and 7-21, restarted the RDMA driver, monitored retransmits. retransmit rate dropped from 18% -> 3% over 8 minutes.

oncall-mike: good signal. how are latencies and error rates?

incident-bot: metrics update: p50/p95 back to baseline, p99 decreasing; 5xx rate dropped from 2.1% -> 0.12% after route fallback + MTU change.

leo-support: sent customer update to affected customers (top 3): heads-up + what we changed + expected follow-up.

dave-sre: also trimmed KV cache growth and made eviction more aggressive to avoid late memory pressure: runtime flag `--kv-evict-thresh=0.65` applied and restarted runtime on two nodes. no OOMs observed since.

anya-ml: note for postmortem: root cause candidate = heterogeneous MTU + multipath path oscillation under load causing high retransmit -> host queuing -> CUDA context timeouts and container restarts.

oncall-mike: handoff: I'm handing to @dave-sre for overnight monitoring at 04:45Z. I'm off in 30. Please escalate to infra if retransmit > 8% again.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-410600 opened. Severity P2. Mitigations: node drain, traffic fallback to quantized_v2, MTU unify to 4092, multipath disabled on affected nodes.

dave-sre: will keep watch. next steps: schedule controlled firmware update on the HCA and a rolling reboot during low-traffic window; infra to validate switch MTU config; infra to run IB path probe across rack-7 for 24h.

leo-support: final customer message queued once postmortem is ready.

oncall-mike: last check before handoff: retransmit 2.9%, p99 within 5% of baseline, no new container restarts. closing active pager. monitoring for 30m then resolve incident. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> status: monitoring. Follow-up tasks created: FUTURE-1234 (firmware), FUTURE-1235 (postmortem), FUTURE-1236 (status page update).

leo-support: added customer impact note: ~2% of requests saw increased latency / 5xx for ~12 minutes; major customers notified.

anyone: please add any missing observations.

oncall-mike: thanks everyone, good recovery.
